map.承载力 = f(土性, 深度, 宽度): Bearing capacity = f(soil properties, depth, width)
map.💡 太沙基条形基础：qu = c·Nc + γ·Df·Nq + 0.5·γ·B·: 💡 Terzaghi strip footing: qu = c·Nc + γ·Df·Nq + 0.5·γ·B·Nγ; characteristic bearing capacity fa = qu / K. The bearing-capacity factors are derived from φ.
map.本公式适用于条形基础、整体剪切破坏模式: This formula applies to strip footings with general shear failure

map.条形基础设计：由粘聚力、内摩擦角、重度算太沙基极限承载力 qu 与特征值 fa: Strip footing design: compute the Terzaghi ultimate bearing capacity qu and characteristic value fa from cohesion, internal friction angle and unit weight
map.地基验算：输入实际基础宽度与埋深，判断 fa 是否满足上部荷载: Foundation check: enter the actual footing width and depth to judge whether fa meets the superstructure load
map.方案比选：变动 φ、c、B、Df 观察承载力变化趋势: Option comparison: vary φ, c, B and Df to observe the trend of bearing capacity
map.算法（太沙基条形基础，整体剪切）：承载力系数 Nq=exp(π·tanφ)·ta: Algorithm (Terzaghi strip footing, general shear): bearing-capacity factors Nq=exp(π·tanφ)·tan²(π/4+φ/2), Nc=(Nq−1)/tanφ (5.14 when φ=0), Nγ=2(Nq+1)·tanφ; ultimate bearing capacity qu=c·Nc+γ·Df·Nq+0.5·γ·B·Nγ; characteristic value fa=qu/K (K the safety factor, default 2). Also outputs the bearing capacity per linear metre fa·B. Requires c≥0, φ≥0, γ>0, B>0, K>0.
map.例：c=15kPa、φ=20°、γ=18kN/m³、B=2m、Df=1.5m、K: Example: c=15 kPa, φ=20°, γ=18 kN/m³, B=2 m, Df=1.5 m, K=2 → Nq=6.40, Nc=14.83, Nγ=5.39; qu=15×14.83+18×1.5×6.40+0.5×18×2×5.39=222.5+172.8+96.9=492.26 kPa; fa=492.26/2=246.13 kPa, 492.26 kN/m per linear metre. If c=10, φ=30, γ=19, B=3, Df=2, K=2 → Nq=18.40, Nc=30.14, Nγ=22.40; qu=1639.11 kPa, fa=819.55 kPa, showing that a larger φ markedly raises the bearing capacity.
map.太沙基公式适用于什么条件？: What conditions does the Terzaghi formula apply to?
map.适用于条形基础、地基发生整体剪切破坏、基础埋深不大且水下用有效重度。圆形/方形基: It applies to strip footings with general shear failure of the subsoil, a modest foundation depth and the effective unit weight below the water table. Circular/square footings, deep foundations or weak underlying layers need correction factors or other formulas (such as Hansen or Vesic); results from this tool are for reference.
map.安全系数 K 取 2 合理吗？: Is a safety factor K of 2 reasonable?
map.K=2~3 是建筑地基常用范围，具体由规范与结构重要性决定。对临时工程可降、对敏: K=2-3 is the common range for building foundations, determined by the code and structural importance. It can be lowered for temporary works and raised for sensitive buildings; fa is only the bearing capacity at the footing base, so settlement and weak underlying layers must also be checked, and fa alone cannot determine the foundation.
